title: 마지막 한 획
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a jazz-influenced progression with seventh chords and subtle vibrato. A sub-bass synth provides low-end weight on the downbeats. The percussion consists of a crisp electronic snare with a short decay and a soft, rounded kick drum. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate style with close-mic proximity and light plate reverb. The arrangement features a minimalist, spacious mix with a focus on vocal clarity and harmonic warmth. Tempo is 72 BPM in the key of G Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggios]
(Hmm-mm)

나조차 비어 있어

멈추지 않았어
